# 8-Bit Pipelined Microprocessor (Verilog HDL)

An 8-bit processor implementation designed and modeled in Verilog HDL. This project demonstrates the progression from a basic **Single-Cycle Microprocessor** to a fully featured **5-Stage Pipelined Microprocessor** equipped with hazard detection, data forwarding, and flush mechanisms.

## Project Overview 

This repository contains the hardware description for a custom 16-bit Instruction Set Architecture (ISA) built with an 8-bit data path:

1. **Phase 1: Single-Cycle Architecture** – Initial baseline design executing every instruction in a single clock cycle to verify functional correctness of the ALU, Register File, Control Unit, and Memory components.

2. **Phase 2: 5-Stage Pipelined Architecture** – Enhanced pipelined implementation operating across Fetch (IF), Decode (ID), Execute (EX), Memory (MEM), and Writeback (WB) stages. Includes a dedicated **Hazard Unit** for data forwarding and stall/flush management to prevent data and control hazards.

## Key Specifications

| Specification | Details |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Data Bus Width** | 8-bit |
| **Instruction Bus Width** | 16-bit |
| **Instruction Formats** | R-type, I-type, J-type, B-type |
| **Opcode Field** | 4 bits (`IR[15:12]`) |
| **Immediate Field** | 8 bits (`IR[7:0]`) — No sign extender required |
| **Register File** | 8 general-purpose registers (8-bit width, 3-bit addressing) |
| **Instruction Memory** | $1024\times 16$\-bit ($1\text{ KB}$ depth, 10-bit address bus `[9:0]`) |
| **Data Memory** | $512\times 8$\-bit ($512\text{ Bytes}$ depth, 9-bit address bus `[8:0]`) |
| **Hazard Resolution** | Data forwarding, pipeline stall generation, and flush control |

&nbsp;

## Instruction Set Architecture (ISA) Formats

All instructions are fixed at 16 bits wide. Opcodes occupy the top 4 bits (`[15:12]`).

```
15        12 11       9 8        6 5                        0
+-----------+----------+----------+--------------------------+
|  Opcode   |  Rx (rd) |  Ry (rs) |       Unused / Misc      |  R-Type
+-----------+----------+----------+--------------------------+

15        12 11       9 8                                   0
+-----------+----------+-------------------------------------+
|  Opcode   |  Rx (rd) |          Immediate (8-bit)          |  I-Type
+-----------+----------+-------------------------------------+

15        12 11                                             0
+-----------+------------------------------------------------+
|  Opcode   |               Target Offset (12-bit)           |  J-Type
+-----------+------------------------------------------------+

15        12 11       9 8        6 5                        0
+-----------+----------+----------+--------------------------+
|  Opcode   |  Rx      |    Ry    |   Offset                 |  B-Type
+-----------+----------+----------+--------------------------+


```

&nbsp;


## Pipeline Stages

The processor divides instruction execution into **5 distinct pipeline stages**:

1. **IF (Instruction Fetch)**:  
   1. Fetches a 16-bit instruction from `InstrMem` using the current Program Counter (`PC`).  
   2. Increments PC for the next cycle.  
2. **ID (Instruction Decode / Register Read)**:  
   1. Decodes the 4-bit opcode via the Control Unit (`CU`).  
   2. Reads source operands from the `Reg` file (`addr_1` and `addr_2`).  
   3. Extracts immediate values (`IR[7:0]`).  
3. **EX (Execute / ALU)**:  
   1. Performs arithmetic or logical operations inside the `ALU1` based on opcode.  
   2. Forwarding logic resolves data hazards by injecting updated register values directly into ALU inputs.  
4. **MEM (Memory Access)**:  
   1. Accesses `DataMem` for load/store instructions using 9-bit memory addresses.  
5. **WB (Write-Back)**:  
   1. Writes the final result (`ALU_out` or memory `out_data`) back to the destination register in the Register File (`Reg`).

&nbsp;

## Source Modules Breakdown

The codebase is organized into modular Verilog files within `Pipelined_Microprocessor_srcs/`:

| Module File | Top Level / Entity | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `Top_module_mp.v` | `top_module` | Top-level module integrating the datapath, memory units, and control logic. |
| `PC.v` | `PC` | Program Counter register managing instruction fetching and jump target updates. |
| `InstrMem.v` | `instruction_mem` | $1024\times 16$\-bit ROM loaded via `instructions.hex`. |
| `DataMem.v` | `data_mem` | $512\times 8$\-bit synchronous RAM for load/store operations. |
| `Reg.v` | `register_file` | Dual-read, single-write 8-bit register file. |
| `ALU1.v` | `ALU` | 8-bit Arithmetic Logic Unit performing arithmetic, logic, and condition checks. |
| `CU.v` | `cu` | Main Control Unit generating pipeline control signals based on opcodes. |
| `hazard_unit.v` | `hazard_unit` | Resolves RAW data hazards via forwarding and manages pipeline stalls/flushes. |
| `instructions.hex` | *N/A* | Hexadecimal machine code file for instruction memory initialization. |
